what: It explores for heavy mineral sands and rare earth elements at the Chilwa Critical Minerals Project in southern Malawi.
proceeds: Chilwa expects about US$2.5 million in net proceeds. It plans to use this, plus its existing cash, for exploration, working capital and general business needs.
risks: It has lost money since it began and expects more losses until the project produces minerals and earns enough revenue.
It needs a lot more money, may not be able to raise it, and there is serious doubt it can keep operating.
Mineral exploration is very risky, and many programs find nothing that can be mined at a profit.
Exploration needs large sums of money, and the real costs and timelines could be much higher than Chilwa expects.
